nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Milk-Peel Gentle Exfoliating Toner

avis.texte: I was surrised how great this toner works. Your skin looks glowy right after the first application. I have sensitige skin and it doesnt irritate me. I would highly recommend this for anyone!
My favorite toner! Super refreshing at night after cleansing. Not super drying. I've lost count of how many bottles I've gone through!
Of the many toners I have tried, this is the best. It delivers what it promises.

This product is hands down the best toner I have ever used. I have really sensitive skin but this is the only toner that actually cleans my pores without burning or redness. I even got my boyfriend to start using and he is also in love with it!
I have used this for many years. I like that it's so gentle that I can use it twice a day. Does not aggravate my very sensitive skin…

avis.titre: Toner that works on sensitive skin
avis.texte: Never used a toner before but love this so far. It helps tackle milia (little white bumps). I also have sensitive skin and it's looking pretty good!!! I recommend!
My skin loves it! I use this or calendula but prefer this one. It feels moisturized without any moisturizer added.
My favorite toner of all. I use this daily and love the glow and how it cleans deep under my pores

There is a reason this one rarely goes on sale. It's by far my favorite product. I have sensitive skin and this does wonders for it. Less acne, smoother, brighter skin and gives it an actual glow. Love it!!

This is EXPENSIVE. I purchased it after it was recommended at the Topanga CA location (I didn't look at the price). But it works so well. I was using a million "hydrating" products but my skin still felt dry throughout the day. The sales rep talked me into buying this and as soon as I tried it I fell in love. It's been about a week that I've been using this product and it feels so nice on my skin. Several of my coworkers today asked me what changed in my skin routine because it looks amazing. This is the only thing I changed. New holy grail!
The product works great. But the bottle leaks (a lot)!!!! Stored upright in cabinet and it's on a tissue which is sopping wet. Can't figure out where it's leaking from.

Product is in a cylinder jar that you twist open. Unfortunately the silver top breaks easily, making it hard to open and leaving you exposed to glue that doesn't dry even after 2 weeks and can get mixed in with your product. If it gets mixed in, it burns when applied to face.

avis.titre: This product was just what I needed!
avis.texte: The best toner I've ever used! I highly recommend adding this into your skincare routine.

I love this product. I traveled to 4 different countries in 3 weeks and I put it my luggage in a ziploc bag, it leaked every time I took it out the bag. Very disappointed. I would purchase again but not bring it to travel.
The brighter more even skin in seven days claim is legit. I only use it at night and I saw those results. And my skin is far from perfect.
I can't say enough good things about this toner. It's gentle and hydrating and leaves my skin super glowy! Using it consistently is like a facial in a bottle!!

Favorite toner ever. I have sensitive acne prone skin and this just works so well for me. So much medication and trying to figure out the cause, my skin gets very dried out but this moisturizes my skin every time I use it

avis.titre: I broke out worse than a teenager
avis.texte: If you start noticing more pimples and breakouts, it's probably this product. I had very clean skin, but wanted to work on some wrinkles that were settling into my forehead so I switched up my routine a bit. Now I have acne and dark spots from acne all over my face, which will probably take months to heal. What works for one person won't work, or will be detrimental to another. I'm writing this review so others will be aware this product does cause breakouts in some people.
Obsessed with this toner. Moisturizes while cleaning the skin. Love it!

My skin generally doesnt go with all type of products and toners are definitely not for me. However, I am so so in love with this milk peel that I want to stock it up for forever. My skin texture is improved. It feels very hydrated naturally and does wonders on pimple scars or uneven tone. My skin is dry in winters and oily combination in summers. I love this all throught the seasons.
I'm very sorry to say that this toner gave me whiteheads. I had never used a toner before and really enjoyed it, but had to stop using it.

What a wonderful product. I even can't imagine that I will see the result in just one use and in a month. It is my first time that I try Kiehls product and I obsess with it and want it for life time. It helps with my acne. I tried a lot of product for acne but they didn't help. This one is like magic. I remcomend this one for everyone. I want moreeeeeeee please.

avis.titre: Must have in your skincare routine!
avis.texte: This product has completely changed my skin texture! I will never not have this in my skin care routine.
I love this exfoliater because it is super gentle while still removing impurities. It makes my skin feel soft and refreshed. One of my staples.
This toner has become as important as moisturizing in my daily routine.

Great toner for combination skin. I will gladly spend the money for this product. It clears the skin at the end of the day from makeup and has salycic acid . Not too harsh. Have been using it for years!
This is the most gentle and effective toner I have ever used. I love it.

avis.titre: Great exfoliating toner for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I needed a mild exfoliating toner to deal with flaky skin from using retinol 2-3 evenings a week. My skin does not tolerate salicylic acid at all and dries it out severely, so I was a little apprehensive since this toner has an SA derivative and only came in this big size, but I'm glad I gave it a chance. I apply this every morning using a cotton pad and it smooths out my skin nicely, without any irritation, dryness, or stinging. I apply Kiehl's ferulic acid essence after this toner and my skin has been hydrated, smooth, and less flaky.
I've been using Milk-Peel product for 1- 2 months. It does a deep cleanse and removes dirt well; however it leaves an oily residue on skin that lasts pretty much all day or night.
Absolutely love this product! We've seen tremendous results in approximately 2 weeks! Can't do without!

I am not joking when I say this changed my almost 50 year old skin. Gave some to my 70 year mother and she loves it, already bought another and told me her skin has never been softer. It's a WINNER !!!

avis.titre: Leaves your skin feeling soft and clean
avis.texte: Very nice! Works great! After cleansing my face and neck with Kiehl's ultra face cleanser, this toner will still take off any remaining residue. It leaves my face very clean and soft, to the point that I sometimes don't use moisturizer. I use it morning and before bed. I am 72 years young and love the Kiehl's products!! Wish I had discovered this line years ago!!!
This has made my skin so soft! I'm really impressed. I only use it at night thought because it does make your face a little oily.

avis.titre: If I Could Only Keep One Toner
avis.texte: This gentle exfoliating toner is transformative. I believe in "hydration hydration hydration" and use 3 toners. If I could only keep one, it would be Kiehls. The lactic acid is a gentle milky hydrating exfoliant. I put mine in a continuous mist bottle so as not to waste a drop of it.

I really wanted to love it, but the first time I tried this I woke up with small bumps around my chin and cheeks. After the second use, it spread to my neck and ears. This is the only product I introduced into my skincare regime. After taking a second look at the ingredients I am wondering if the essential oils are the issue.

I have only been using the milk peel toner for two weeks and already see a huge change in my skin. I could actually see a big difference even after the first use. The skin between my eyebrows is normally extremely dry and my makeup looks nasty when applied there. But since I've been using this toner in the morning and before bed it's been better than ever. I highly recommend the Kiehl's Milk Peel Toner. In my eyes it's a miracle worker! 100/10

I have not been using a tonic before receiving this one. My skin has appreciated it a lot, it is softer and my skin tone begins to even out. I really love it! It has also helped with my acne and my rosacea.
This is by the far the best toner I have ever used! It's pricey but worth every penny! Its so gentle and makes your skin feel like a baby's butt!

I love this product! I use it for both my morning and night skin care routine. While I do not have acne, I always had textured skin. You could see tiny skin colored bumps on my nose & forehead l well they are gone. Now my face feels so smooth & moisturized. I wish they sold this in a travel size bottle or something. I carry the entire big bottle everytime I travel & the way the packaging is set up id have to break the seal to pour it into a TSA approved carry on bottle

This is truly my holy grail skincare product & I started off by using it as a sample. Fell in love and purchased the full size. I tend to have normal/dry skin and it doesn't disrupt my moisture barrier at all. I use on a cotton pad roughly once a morning & even sometimes at night after a long day of makeup or SPF wear.
I have been using this product for a little over a year and it has greatly improved my skin. If this ever gets discontinued, please warn me so I can stock up!!!
Love it!. It made such a difference in my skin in terms of smoothness and look.

avis.titre: Don't throw out the little thing in the lid
avis.texte: This toner is great except I threw out the little part in the lid that I thought was just packaging. Every time I go to use the toner, because you have to shake it, I get a whole bunch that spills out of the lid.

A girlfriend raved about this product, I am pretty set with my skin care products but decided to try to add this toner specifically for sun damage on my neck and chest. (I have been contemplating more invasive procedures for the chest area and wrinkled skin). Can't believe what a difference this product has explicitly made in that area in just a couple weeks. Sincerely shocked by how well it worked. I will continue using to see if the improvements continues, stays the same or fades with use but so far in love with this toner. Likely to be a regular product in my skincare routine!
Love this toner! I upgraded from the Ordinary and I'm seeing such a difference.
My new fave toner. This is my second bottle now. My face was super dry. When i used this with moisturizer it moisten my skin. Excellent product. ❤️
Love love LOVE this!! It has smoothed my skin and gives a beautiful moisturizing glow!

I have an intense skin regimen as I am 50 and never had a skin regimen so I've been trying to find products to help with pores, oiliness, dark spots/scars. I'm not sure if this is a toner or an exfoliator even tho both is in the title. I use it as an exfoliator because I use something else as a toner. Since I've taken better care of my skin, it's not as oily as it used to be. This does not make my skin oily, but soft and hydrated after using my toner. I received it as a sample and fell in love immediately. For now, I use it day and night. In the future, I may have to lower the usage but I just love the way it makes my skin feels. I haven't seen any real results yet since I've only used it for a few days but I know the results will be awesome once I start using it more. I think it would be great for all skin types.

avis.titre: It's great, but not for daily use!
avis.texte: Too harsh to use daily so i use it 2x a week & only at night. It give my skin a clean, clear, soft look.
Gentle exfoliator to use everyday. Really improves skin's texture, smoothing out fine lines. Help to set up skin for serum and moisturizer. No fragrance and gentle on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Dry and long term spots and sunburn
avis.texte: I have a combination skin, trust me this is the best product I've ever used and got the best results. My skin feels soft and looks youthful
I have dry skin and this adds some hydration to my skin. Hopefully it is gently exfoliating it at the same time.

avis.titre: Wasn't a believer of toners UNTIL NOW :)
avis.texte: Wasn't a believer of toners (tried many brands in the past, including very expensive ones) UNTIL NOW! Love this toner and the "milk" factor! Very hydrating and makes my skin glow, using this product alone. I pay closer attention to my skin since I do a lot more videos nowadays.
The milk peel, exfoliation toner, leaves your skin, silky, smooth and moisturize. I have recommended this to all of my friends and family.

This is a nice toner. I've tried other toners from Kiehl's that I've liked a bit more simply because I feel, for my skin type, this can leave my face looking oily. It smells good, feels good, but I have to use in more moderation than others.

I have been using this for about a year. I don't use a cotton ball, just a few drops and I rub it into my face after cleansing. Love, love, love this toner! Completely changed the texture of my skin and my skin is healthy, moisturized and radiant! This is a must buy!
Best toner I have ever used.really makes a difference. Not drying.

avis.titre: First time toner…SO GLAD ITS THIS ONE
avis.texte: Love this toner!! I have never used toner before this but it is seriously amazing. It brightens up my face and feels so hydrating. I use twice a day with exfoliating wipes. The wipes show the dirt and oils being removed from your face. I'm already almost out of it because of how much I use it but it does last for a while. I shake before every use. It does not dry out your face like I hear other toners do because it does not have alcohol. This is great for people with oily or dry skin!! Definitely purchasing again.
Love this for days when my skin is feeling dry. Love the milky nourishment

Second Bottle and I love it. I am 37 and needed and extra care in my routine. It is gentle and even though I use a facewash, this toner helps remove that extra dirt from your face that maybe the facewash didn't and it doesn't leave my face dry or red. I have notice that helps my pores just be extra clean more than usual and in between my once a week mud mask application. I know is not intended for any other body parts, but I use it on my underarms because I don't use any deodorant at all and it helps with my natural body odor.

avis.titre: Everytime I used this, WORSENS my skin
avis.texte: Loyal Kiehls user, but this did worst on me. 1st try got small bumps & redness all over my face, continued for a few days thinking reaction will eventually disappear but did not, worsened my face with severe dryness all over. Stopped and used again for the ff week, same result. Stopped & used again the ff month, same discouraging result. I am not sure what's in this toner that worsens my skin everytime I use. Eventually got tired of trying this & wasted my money 😫

First got this toner as a sample, and fell in love with it by the time the sample was finished. It is 100% better than previous toners I have used. They dried out my skin from all the alcohol content, but this milk-peel is gentle and leaves my skin looking refreshed and hydrated. You won't regret it!

I love this product! It is such a great calming and balancing exfolitor and toner in one! It leaves skin refreshed, dewy and ready to receive moisture. I pair this with the ferulic serum and together they have transformed my skin. I can actually use retinol and not feel overly dry and peeling the day after. Love this stuff!

I love the Kiehl's Milk-Peel toner! It removes dirt and leaves a my skin nicely moisturized. I have skin that tends to get dry after washing and this toner adds a layer of moisture while toning and cleaning my face. It's almost like a serum. This is my 4th bottle and I really love this product.

avis.titre: Made my skin smoother and brighter
avis.texte: Gentle enough for daytime and nighttime use before moisturizer. Skin looks cleaner and brighter after a few days use. I love this product and will continue to use it for as long as its available.
I love this toner and how it makes my skin feel. Also have it on hand. Especially during the warmer months.

I was hesitant at first when a friend gifted me this toner. But I end using it and I notoce it is gentle. A few weeks and I saw something change in my facial skin tone. It is noticeably smoother and just simply improved. That's why i bought my first bottle.
Best Toner I Have ever used in my life. It cleans all the pores and leaves very smooth texture.
This is this my favorite toner ever. It leaves my skin so soft while helping me remove dead cells.
LOVE THIS! It gives my face an amazing glow & doesn't leave a sticky residue. I have sensitive skin & I have no issues with this product. 100% recommend!!!
This toner keeps my 60-year-old skin moisturized and glowing.
I've been using this for a week only in the evenings. I'm noticing that my mild bumpy skin got smoother already and skin feels so much cleaner.
This is the best toner, full stop. Exfoliates and hydrates at the same time and leaves my skin glowing.

Oh wow, this is such a nice toner! I tried this out for it's gentle exfoliating factor. This toner helps remove any remaining residue after cleansing and properly preps my skin for my next step. I also love the super mild consistency that feels so soft on my face. After using my first bottle, I do notice a more even texture and brighter complexion. Short story: in LOVE.
I use this toner nightly, the difference is amazing. It has evened out my skin tone, leaving my face soft and smooth.
It's very gentle and doesn't dry out my skin. It has a light scent and my skin feels soft.
I have been using this for about 3 weeks now and my skin is glowing! It feels clean and fresh going on and smells great.
New best friend, love skins texture after application, gentle too!
Rarely do I use something and say -wow this actually works…this does!
This product seems quite useless. I see no positive or negative effects. I will be going back to my old toner which had many more of the classic toner qualities

I love this gentle exfoliating toner! It's great on my sensitive skin, and I use it twice a day. I already see improvement in my skin texture after only 2 weeks. I recommend this product and was not paid to write it!

I am loving this! So many toners sting my face, I really can't use most AHA, glycolic, etc, however, THIS one, I can use, and it feels great, and doesn't sting, and my dry skin doesn't react badly to it. Skin is looking GOOD! Great product!!

My skin has always been on the oily side and I tend to avoid moisturizers. This is a great compromise! Leaves my skin feeling so soft and the tone more even. I've only used it for a couple of weeks but the effect on skin tone is almost immediate. I've always had trouble remembering to use toner and making it a part of my routine, but now I find myself going out of my way to make sure I don't forget to wash my face in the morning JUST so I can use this toner. Please make a travel size because the nature of this product/packaging makes it difficult to transfer to smaller containers!
Very gentle and refreshing. I use it every night and morning. Makes my face feel ultra clean.

avis.titre: I love my new face toner
avis.texte: I have been looking for a new face toner and this is it. My skin looks and feels super clean and glowy and smooth even before applying the rest of my Kiehl's regimine.

Bought this toner for my daughter and she loves it. I've been used Kielh's ultra facial toner for years and have been happy until I tried this. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and hydrated. I have combination skin so it works great for me. Definitely would not recommend it for someone with oily skin. I actually don't use a cotton pad. I just pour a little on my skin and pat it all over my face. Love this toner!!

avis.titre: Mix well and save it for the winter
avis.texte: It feels slightly oily sometimes on my combination/neutral skin, but it's generally good and nurturing. I used origin's mega mushroom for a few years so I was expecting something lighter for a toner. I think this to be a good toner for the winter, dry weather. I haven't used it long enough to see the effect on evening skin tone yet.
I'm in love with this toner. I was never a to er person, but i got a sample of this and am converted. It leaves your skin so soft and supple. Its amazing.
I use some of Toner before I met Kiehls. I like this Toner it helps to improve my skin with hydration and smooth

I never had a real skincare routine - I'm kind of a tomboy, and never even washed my face at night - but my boyfriend (who loves Kiehl's) convinced me to go in and talk with a Kiehl's professional. I came out with the Midnight Recovery Botanical Cleansing Oil, this Milk Peel Gentle Exfoliating Toner, and the Ultra Facial Cream. I have been using this routine religiously for two months now, and saw a photo the other day and could not believe the difference. My skin color has even changed! I swear the Milk Peel Toner is the main reason - I absolutely love how it feels on my face, and how supple my skin feels immediately after applying it. I don't wear nearly as much makeup anymore, because I feel so confident with just a fresh face.

By far the best toner!!! I absolutely love this toner. Removes dirt without leaving my skin feeling stripped and dry. My skin feels moisturized and really clean afterwards. I have tried a lot of toners and this had become my "it" toner. Please do not change anything about this toner. It's perfect!
Great glow after using. The exfoliating shows the dirt removed, which is satisfying.
Really love it. Hoping to see improvements over the long term.
I use this in the morning/night and noticed my skin looks and feels great!
My daughter raves about this toner, I waited until I decided to give it a try, and I don't have the words for what this toner has done to my skin. It's like I swallowed the Sun. I am a fan for life
I just love this milk-peel toner. it sets the tone for the other products. Keeps skin hydrated all day. Too much will leave skin looking too oily. Just a small amount on a cotton pad does the trick.
Somehow oily. not so 'refreshing' but it does great job to smooth skin and wipe out dust.
I was hesitant at first just because a not really a toner person but I have definitely seen improvements on the clarity of my skin. Absolutely love it!
This stuff is great--just the right weight, feels great to use, and leaves my skin soft and glowing. I feel like it "sets the table" for my moisturizer. I look forward to using it every time!
Love this!! Been using for a while now and when I first started using, I noticed a difference right away!

avis.titre: A must in the skin care routine
avis.texte: Ever since I started using the peel, the smoothness of my face is absolutely visible. My pores are even smaller!
Amazing ! I started off with the samples and than I just went ahead and got the real deal . If you have extremely oily skin than it's not for you but overall it's pretty good toner
I love it! My skin is so soft thanks to this! Definitely worth every penny!

I didn't notice any difference in my skin appearance. It is very gentle, maybe too gentle for me. I love that it's packaged in a glass bottle as I'm being more mindful about reducing plastic use. Its hard to explain, but I found the application to be a little messy though. After shaking the bottle, product would get stay in the top and then when I opened it, product would leak out.

I love this exfoliating toner! Unlike other toners, this one actually seems to do something. My skin feels more bright and smooth. Quickly becoming a Kiehls fan and see why a derm lead brand is worth the $$$.
It leaves your skin filling fresh and clean. I have found with my twice daily usage my skin does fill as dry throughout the day.
Wonderful, I have greasy texture and large pores so this toner gives me an instant radiance and tighter pores.I use after the Paula choislce BHA liquid and does wonder.

avis.titre: A product I CANNOT live without!
avis.texte: By far my favorite Kiehl's product. I love this toner and how much it has changed the overall appearance and glow of my skin. I recommend this product to everyone that asks about my skincare! 10/10 must need.
leaves your face so soft silky and milky. Great for everyday use.

I got a sample from the store. Usually after wash my face, I feel my face is dry. But my skin feels smooth after apply it. I also like it has a bit orange scent. So I purchased it for the very first time, it came with a good quality glass bottle. Very nice.

This product is awesome! As an ER nurse who wears multiple masks for 12+ hours, I was finding new & painful break outs at the end of every shift. Not anymore! I apply this to my face in the AM and come home daily with soft, even, moisturized skin and best of all no new breakouts! I couldn't recommend a product more!

This is one of those holy grail products for me that I keep reordering. I really love it and don't ever want to be without it. It tones, but it also gently hydrates and it seems to balance out my skin a bit. My skin really loves it.
Feels so nice on my skin. My face feels so soft and smooth and the toner makes it feel like my face is closed after a shower and it has a barrier on it to keep moisture in.
Gently smoothed away my rough patches including porous areas, no redness just milky softness! My foundation goes on much easier no caking just smooth soft skin ordering 2nd bottle!
I love the way my face feels after I use this Milk-Peel Gentle Exfoliating Toner it's a great first step before I use the micro dose anti-aging-retinol-serum!
I've noticed a major difference in my skin with this toner. Brightens my skins with the whole process. Even if I don't moisturize this toner alone hydrates the skin.
My skin looks smoother than before! Try it and you'll love it
